step1_analysis.circuit_type: Transimpedance Amplifier Core for a Programmable-Gain Amplifier
step1_analysis.description: A fully differential, self-biased transimpedance amplifier core. It uses active feedback (via XM3/XM4) to achieve low input impedance at nodes N_M7_D and N_M8_D, and is intended to be driven by switched input resistors to form a highly linear programmable-gain voltage amplifier.

paper_reference.title: A Highly Linear 125-MHz CMOS Switched-Resistor Programmable-Gain Amplifier

Transimpedance_Gain.description: Midband transimpedance gain of the core amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a 1kOhm input resistor was used for the 19dB voltage gain, Z_T = 10^(19/20) * 1k = 8.9 kOhm. In dB(Ohm), this is 20*log10(8900) = 79 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The core must provide high transimpedance to allow the external switched resistors to accurately set the voltage gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Sky130 (130nm) has higher fT than 0.35um, so bandwidth should easily meet or exceed the original design.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Maintained constant bandwidth is a key feature of this PGA topology.

sky130_expected.calculation: Scaling supply from 3.3V to 1.8V, assuming similar bias currents (~6.3mA total), Power = 1.8V * 6.3mA = 11.3 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Lower supply voltage in Sky130 directly reduces power consumption for the same bias current.

sky130_expected.calculation: -86 dB corresponds to roughly 0.005% distortion. THD should be in a similar ultra-low range.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The active feedback topology is specifically chosen to maximize linearity.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure transimpedance gain, bandwidth, power, and linearity of the PGA core.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PGA Core Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameter definitions
.param W_xm25=5u L_xm25=0.5u
.param W_xm23=5u L_xm23=0.5u
.param W_xm21=5u L_xm21=0.5u
.param W_xm27=5u L_xm27=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm26=5u L_xm26=0.5u
.param W_xm24=5u L_xm24=0.5u
.param W_xm22=5u L_xm22=0.5u
.param W_xm28=5u L_xm28=0.5u

* DUT Instantiation
XM25 N_M25_D VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm25} w={W_xm25}
XM23 N_M21_D N_M21_D N_M25_D VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm23} w={W_xm23}
XM21 N_M21_D VIP N_M21_S VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm21} w={W_xm21}
XM27 N_M21_S VBN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm27} w={W_xm27}
XM7 N_M7_D VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM3 N_M7_D VOM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM9 N_M9_D VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM1 N_M9_D N_M7_D N_M1_S VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM5 N_M1_S VBN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM15 N_M15_D VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM11 VOM N_M9_D N_M15_D VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM13 VOM VBN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM12 VOP N_M10_D N_M15_D VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM14 VOP VBN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM10 N_M10_D VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM2 N_M10_D N_M8_D N_M2_S VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM6 N_M2_S VBN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM8 N_M8_D VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM4 N_M8_D VOP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM26 N_M26_D VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm26} w={W_xm26}
XM24 N_M22_D N_M22_D N_M26_D VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm24} w={W_xm24}
XM22 N_M22_D VIM N_M22_S VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm22} w={W_xm22}
XM28 N_M22_S VBN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm28} w={W_xm28}

* Power Supplies and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VVBP VBP 0 0.99
VVBN VBN 0 0.54

* Dummy bias for isolated input branches to prevent floating nodes
VVIP VIP 0 0.9
VVIM VIM 0 0.9

* Differential Current Inputs to the core (AC=1A diff for Z_T measurement, Tran=20uA p-p diff)
IinP 0 N_M7_D DC 0 AC 0.5 SIN(0 10u 10Meg)
IinM 0 N_M8_D DC 0 AC -0.5 SIN(0 -10u 10Meg)

* Ideal balun/difference amplifier for easy measurement
E_DIFF VDIFF 0 VOP VOM 1

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis (Transimpedance Gain & Bandwidth)
  ac dec 20 1Meg 10Gig
  meas ac midband_gain max vdb(VDIFF)
  let gain_3db = midband_gain - 3
  meas ac bw when vdb(VDIFF)=$&gain_3db fall=1
  print midband_gain bw

  * 3. Transient Analysis (Swing & Linearity)
  tran 1n 500n
  meas tran vout_max max v(VDIFF)
  meas tran vout_min min v(VDIFF)
  let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
  print vout_pp
  
  * THD Measurement at 10 MHz
  fourier 10Meg v(VDIFF)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
